headline: Eagle Point Software Acquires Global eTraining to Expand Learning Capabilities
summary: Eagle Point Software has acquired Global eTraining to combine complementary technologies and expand applied learning solutions across architectural, engineering, construction, and manufacturing industries.
why: Strategic software acquisitions allow vertical market technology providers to cross-sell specialized training platforms and expand their enterprise customer bases.

impacts.name: Eagle Point Software
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's product portfolio and market reach in design and manufacturing software.
